err(q'[BEGIN commission_pkg.set_commission_splits(3,split_alloc_tab(split_alloc_t(1,50),split_alloc_t(1,50)),'characterizer'); END;]',-20006);
    err(q'[BEGIN commission_pkg.set_commission_splits(3,split_alloc_tab(split_alloc_t(NULL,100)),'characterizer'); END;]',-20006);

ok(commission_pkg.resolve_tier_rate('WL-PAR','T1',DATE '2025-07-01')=45,'July 1 uses OLD 45 not spec 40');
    err(q'[DECLARE x NUMBER; BEGIN x:=commission_pkg.resolve_tier_rate('WL-PAR','T1',DATE '2020-01-01'); END;]',-20007);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT action) INTO v FROM rate_audit_log WHERE actor='characterizer' AND logged_at IS NOT NULL AND detail IS NOT NULL;
    ok(v=5,'RATE_UPSERT/RATE_END/SPLIT_SET/COMMISSION_CALC/POLICY_LAPSE audited');

SELECT tier_code INTO txt FROM fact_commission WHERE policy_id=1019 AND entry_type='COMMISSION'; ok(txt='T1','DW 50000=T1');
    SELECT tier_code INTO txt FROM commission_pay.commission_ledger WHERE policy_id=1019 AND entry_type='COMMISSION'; ok(txt='T2','OLTP 50000=T2');

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v FROM fact_commission f JOIN commission_pay.commission_ledger l ON l.policy_id=f.policy_id AND l.entry_type=f.entry_type WHERE f.policy_id=1034 AND f.entry_type='CHARGEBACK' AND f.tier_code='T1' AND l.tier_code IS NULL;
    ok(v=1,'DW T1 versus null OLTP tier on chargeback');
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v FROM fact_commission WHERE policy_id=1040; ok(v=1,'initial source fact present');

SELECT refresh_mode INTO txt FROM user_mviews WHERE mview_name='MV_AGENT_COMMISSION_SUMMARY'; ok(txt='DEMAND','summary refresh mode DEMAND');
    SELECT last_refresh_date INTO txt FROM user_mviews WHERE mview_name='MV_AGENT_COMMISSION_SUMMARY'; ok(txt IS NOT NULL,'explicit refresh was recorded');

err(q'[INSERT INTO commission_ledger(policy_id,agent_id,period_month,rate_id,split_pct,base_premium,commission_amt) SELECT policy_id,agent_id,'2028-02',rate_id,split_pct,base_premium,commission_amt FROM commission_ledger WHERE policy_id=1024]',-4091);
